notes: East end of Nassau and the north edge of Eden Park. Nassau (60', 6 in. pipe) recorded as 'Nassau Street' to match sheets 178/179. St. James Av. jogs at Nassau: the piece south of Nassau (60', x 580-790) and the piece north of Nassau (x 1147-1322, label 'ST. JAMES AV.', width not printed here, 36 in. pipe) are offset by about 550 px, so they are recorded as 'St. James Avenue (south of Nassau)' and 'St. James Avenue (north of Nassau)'. Alpine Pl. (printed 'ALPINE PL.', 50') runs straight south from Nassau to St. Paul Pl.; its straight north end at Nassau is marked 'NOT OPEN' (the Nassau building line is dashed across it), so the Alpine/Nassau T at (1840,560) is a platted, not-open junction. The open street that leaves Alpine's west side at about y 900-1280, curves west and runs to St. James Av. just south of Nassau (between the Nassau line and the block at y~810, 4 in. and 24 in. pipes in it) carries no name; it is recorded as part of Alpine Place (the opened route of Alpine to the street system) with bends along the curve; its centreline is the midline of its two curved building lines (~45 ft apart). Kemper Lane (from sheet 199, 60', lines at x 2687 and 2900) comes down to Nassau from the north; Luray Av. (printed 'LURAY AV. (DODD PL.)', about 65 ft between its solid west line and dashed east (park) line, width not printed) leaves Nassau's south side about 105 px east of Kemper's centre and curves SSE then SSW down the east side of the sheet to St. Paul Pl.; the two Nassau points are kept separate because of the offset. St. Paul Pl. (printed 'ST. PAUL PL.') runs east from Alpine to Luray along the park; only its north building line (y~3583) is drawn, so its centre is taken at the 6 in. pipe (y~3667), 85 px (25 ft) south of that line; width not printed. Alpine and Luray both continue south of St. Paul Pl. only as dashed Eden Park drives, which also loop round from the foot of St. James Av. to the water tower; park drives are not recorded.
